thread:
anya (release): FYI embedding service in eu-west1 showing small QPS regression ~6% since 10:02. Perf suspects aggressive KV eviction path. Requesting hotfix in the 15m change window.

vin (sre): ack. Can we do a short canary? If not, expedited skip requires ENG+SRE approvals + oncall. Need image sha and smoke criteria.

ravi (eng): image gcr.redwood/embed:hotfix-6999@sha256:c0ffee12. Patch disables fast-evict and adds metric evict_guard. Staging smoke + perf ok.

sam (oncall): oncall here, will monitor logs and alerts.

anya (release): smoke checklist: 1) /health 200 2) p50 within baseline +10ms 3) evict_guard <= current median. rollback triggers: sustained error-rate +2% for 90s OR p95 > baseline +150ms for 2m -> pin old sha256:abba1234 and shift back.

vin (sre): sharing checklist with deploy team. +1 SRE if rollback plan is clear.

ravi (eng): +1 ENG.

anya (release): we have approvals. Requesting expedited skip-canary due to noisy canary traffic. Release note stub: "hotfix: mitigate KV eviction loop affecting embeddings in eu-west1; monitoring ON; CS notified."

releasebot: Received deploy request. Policy expedited-skip validated: ENG+SRE+oncall present. Proceeding.

deploy-bot: Starting deploy embed -> sha256:c0ffee12. Canary skipped. Rollout id rl-6999998888-1. Immediate traffic shift.

sam (oncall): seeing a brief spike of 429s at +12s, auto-rollback not triggered. p50 stable.

ravi (eng): evict_guard metric down, no regressions observed.

vin (sre): passing initial 5m. silencing non-actionable alerts for rollout. continuing to monitor full window.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete -> success rl-6999998888-1.

anya (release): thanks team. Follow-ups: open PR to add a deploy-bot canary guard for 429 spikes >0.5% and update oncall playbook.

ravi (eng): will open PR today.

vin (sre): monitors on watch for 24h. closing thread unless regression appears. :white_check_mark:
